claim_boundary: This report attaches reproducible transcript/audio/feature measurements to queued samples. It does not convert proxies into vocal or nonverbal meaning, verify speaker/event identity, establish editing or room causes, or establish effectiveness or audience outcomes.

metric_definitions.words_per_second_proxy: retained caption word count divided by caption duration
metric_definitions.transcript_gap_*: gaps between adjacent retained caption boundaries
metric_definitions.mean_rms_db: mean decoded-audio RMS proxy over overlapping windows
metric_definitions.speech_activity_fraction: fraction of overlapping windows crossing the coarse activity threshold
metric_definitions.mean_pitch_hz_proxy: coarse spectral pitch estimate where available
metric_definitions.nearest_sampled_frame: closest stored frame sample to queued interval midpoint

Frame face/smile counts are detector candidates, not facial emotion or engagement.
